Active Sourcing
Du findest passende Trainer:innen in ganz Deutschland über Instagram, LinkedIn und andere Kanäle, sprichst sie direkt an und machst sie neugierig auf LIFTED.

Screening
Du sichtest eingehende Bewerbungen, schätzt ein, wer zu uns passt, und hältst den Überblick über alle Kandidat:innen im Prozess.

Du führst die ersten Interviews, lernst die Kandidat:innen kennen und stellst LIFTED vor.

Bevor wir TrainerInnen einstellen, laden wir sie zu einem Tryout ins Studio ein. So lernen wir sie kennen und sehen sie in Action. Du planst diese Tryouts und koordinierst die Termine mit Kandidat:innen und Team.

Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir unser Recruiting weiterentwickeln können, z.B. durch sauberes Tracking.

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Product/Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

  • Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams.

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.
